d: Talabat is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

As an Account Manager at Talabat (Qatar), you will be responsible for managing and growing relationships with our restaurant and vendor partners. You will serve as the main point of contact, helping them optimize their presence on our platform, grow their sales, and ensure a high level of partner satisfaction.
Build and maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing restaurant and vendor partners.
Ensure high partner satisfaction and retention through proactive communication, support, and service excellence.
Serve as a trusted advisor, providing partners with insights that support their business growth on the platform.
Analyze sales, operational, and engagement data to identify areas for improvement in menu performance, pricing, promotions, and delivery logistics.
Share actionable recommendations based on performance metrics to drive revenue and efficiency.
Conduct regular business reviews to align on results, opportunities, and growth plans.
Identify growth opportunities within the portfolio – upsell services, suggest cross-promotions, and improve partner performance.
Support partners in optimizing content (e.g., menu structure, images, delivery times) for better customer engagement and conversion.
Recommend and coordinate marketing campaigns and promotional offers to drive order volume.
Collaborate closely with internal teams such as Marketing, Logistics, and Operations to address partner needs and resolve issues promptly.
Ensure smooth onboarding, campaign execution, and issue resolution for assigned accounts.
Negotiate and renew commercial agreements to ensure a fair and strategic partnership.
Ensure partners comply with service-level agreements and maintain operational standards, including delivery quality and availability.
q: 2+ years of experience in Account Management, Sales, or Partner Success (experience in food tech, FMCG, or e-commerce is a plus).
Strong analytical skills; comfortable working with data dashboards and Excel/Google Sheets to analyze performance and generate insights.
Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
Customer-first mindset with a strong focus on delivering value to partners.
Self-starter with the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Must be a native Arabic speaker.

d: Contributes to the stability and growth of the Hospital by ensuring that it operates within the legal framework and regulatory requirements of the Kingdom, by providing legal advice and handling all related legal cases.
q: A minimum of five (5) to nine (9) years of relevant professional experience is required.
r: Advises senior management on legal issues affecting the Organization.
Develops and maintains the Organization's standard terms and conditions for all commercial contracts.

Ensures the legal terms and conditions of draft contracts to assure compliance with relevant Saudi law and regulations. Develops and maintains the hospital's standard terms and conditions for all commercial contracts.
Prepares and formulates decisions and directives related to the activities of the Organization and expresses viewpoints on the relevant legislative tools.
Organizes legal opinions on major regulatory and legal issues.
Advises the Hospital, including individuals as employees/departments and executives / BOD regarding corporate scope of activities on legal strategy for litigation or settlement of Hospital disputes.

Keeps pace with the changes and modifications introduced to the local, regional and international agreements and legislations, and studies their effect on the organization. Advises the Senior Management on all relevant regulations from government or other bodies.
Advises on issues pertinent to the implementation and application of the ethical and legal principles for practicing medical professionals and conducts appropriate investigations in this concern.
Advises on any legal aspects with respect to the Hospital’s policies and procedures.
Advises on international best practices for providing legal services.
Renders legal opinion in matters related to personnel as required. Interprets the Employee Relations Manual (ERM) and any other legal provisions.
Master’s, Bachelor’s Degree in Law, or other related discipline is required.

d: Movandi's RFIC team develops advanced integrated circuits for 5G as well as SATCOM applications. As an RF IC Layout Engineer, you will be part of a key team designing highly sophisticated mm-Wave transceiver products. Responsibilities would include layout and verification of circuits such as Bandgap bias circuits, LDOs, amplifiers, VCOs, mixers, frequency multipliers/dividers, ADCs, etc. using industry standard tools Cadence, PVS, Calibre, etc.
q: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering preferred, and/or 5+ years related industry experience.
Must have effective interpersonal, teamwork, and communication skills
Must have the ability to multi-task in a fast-paced dynamic environment
Hands-on experience in laying out analog/RF circuits such as: RX/TX sub-blocks, PLLs, Bandgap bias circuits, regulators, and other analog/RF circuits.
Preferably experienced in mmWave RF ICs 20-40GHz or higher.
Preferably experienced in Global Foundries SiGe and/or FDX processes. TSMC sub-micron CMOS technologies.
Able to manage floorplan from unit cells, to block levels, to top level.
Strong knowledge of Cadence, PVS, Calibre tools. Unix and Skill experience helpful.
Strong knowledge on IC layout techniques for high frequency design. Parasitics, Coupling, EMIR, IR Drop, Symmetry.
Able to troubleshoot and solve LVS DRC ERC errors.
English oral and written communication skills required
Minimum 15 years' oil & gas industry experience, including 10 years in process commissioning, start-up, and operations readiness for onshore and offshore facilities.
Proven experience in pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up, testing, and handover of major capital projects.
Hands-on experience with Completions Management Systems (CMS) and systems turnover processes.
Experience conducting or witnessing FAT, SAT, and performance testing of process systems and equipment.
Practical knowledge of HAZOP, HAZID, SIMOPS, and commissioning risk management.
Strong understanding of offshore production facilities and associated process systems.
Excellent leadership, stakeholder management, and communication skills.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to work effectively in fast-paced project environments and deliver results under pressure.
Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering from a recognized University.
r: Lead and coordinate pre-commissioning, commissioning, start-up, testing, and handover activities for major oil and gas projects. Responsible for ensuring the safe and efficient commissioning of process facilities, including separation, gas treatment, compression, utilities, and produced water treatment systems. Work closely with project teams, contractors, and operations personnel to achieve operational readiness, manage system completion activities, and ensure compliance with project specifications, industry standards, and HSE requirements. Drive the successful delivery of commissioning objectives through effective planning, stakeholder coordination, problem-solving, and leadership throughout the transition from project execution to operations.

d: Responsible for providing comprehensive nursing care utilizing the nursing process and meeting the established standard of nursing practice and performance.
q: Associate Degree/Diploma in Nursing is required.
Current Registered Nurse Licensure from country of origin and Saudi Commission for Health Specialties Licensure is required.
Specialized Hospital training; i.e. midwifery or certified Nursing Assistant is required.
r: Provides total patient care as assigned according to the core standards of patient care and established policies and evidence-based practices.
Assumes accountability for assessing, planning, implementing and evaluating care as well as discharge planning for each patient.
Contributes to decreasing the length of stay/waiting time as per unit specific goal. Works in collaboration with Case Management to achieve goals.
Documents all relevant information correctly, appropriately, and in a timely manner.
Reports equipment failures, safety and security issues, and/or reduction of supply inventory to Head Nurse or designee.
Contributes to the achievement of cost efficiency savings on unit. Maintains an awareness of resource utilization, exercising care in the ordering and use of staff, equipment, and materials.
Monitors activities in the patient waiting areas and informs appropriate individuals of unusual occurrences.
